source.code:
/--
Checks whether the Boolean predicate `p` returns `true` for every character in a substring.

Short-circuits at the first character for which `p` returns `false`.
-/
@[inline] def all (s : Substring.Raw) (p : Char → Bool) : Bool :=
  !s.any (fun c => !p c)
